rules.title: Ban on Anticompetitive Rent-Setting Software
rules.requirement: The city prohibits the sale, licensing, provision, and use of certain algorithmic rent-setting software for residential rental properties that relies on nonpublic competitor data, while exempting software that relies solely on public data, aggregate historical data, or affordable housing compliance tools.
rules.key_value: civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits, excluding pricing software using solely publicly available data, aggregate historical data, or tools for affordable housing program compliance.

rules.exemptions: Pricing software that relies solely on publicly available data, aggregate historical data, or tools used to comply with affordable housing program requirements.
rules.quoted_span: prohibits the sale, licensing, provision and use of certain algorithmic rent-setting software for residential rental properties.
